claims.assertion: Cassia says an Earth incarnation produces a distinct personality from an off-world life of the same soul.
claims.speaker: Cassia of Erra
claims.qualifiers: Mari says she prepared Cassia’s message for publication.

claims.assertion: Cassia says identical beings usually become separate points of attention rather than one consciousness inhabiting both.
claims.speaker: Cassia of Erra

claims.assertion: Cassia warns Earth memories may be fragmentary and distorted by current context, imagination and the brain’s interpretation.
claims.speaker: Cassia of Erra
claims.qualifiers: The cited warning includes Nai’s comment.

claims.assertion: Cassia says past-life memories should inspire the current self, not justify replacing it or taking another being’s place.
claims.speaker: Cassia of Erra
